packageRules.description: Override security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm (pulled in via config:best-practices), which sets 3 days for the npm datasource and would otherwise shadow our top-level 7 days.
Pin prod dependencies too (devDependencies are covered by :pinDevDependencies from config:best-practices) — this is an app, not a library, so nobody consumes our ranges.

Renovate can't validate release age for these update types (they carry no releaseTimestamp, so the stability check would stay pending forever). The 7-day gate is enforced by pnpm's minimumReleaseAge at resolution time and re-verified by CI's pnpm install.
The browsers come from nixpkgs' playwright-driver (flake.nix) and must be the same Playwright version, so bump @playwright/test manually together with flake.lock.
Node majors (.nvmrc) and @types/node majors must match nodejs_* in flake.nix, so they're bumped manually together with it and @tsconfig/node*.
Exclude pre-1.0.0 versions from auto-merge (0.x minor bumps can be breaking by semver convention). Must come after the automerge rules so it overrides them.
Re-enable auto-merge for oxfmt despite 0.x: a formatting change fails CI's treefmt --ci, so a breaking bump can't merge silently. Must come after the 0.x exclusion.
stylelint-config-* majors enable or drop rules of a specific stylelint major, so a lone bump fails with 'Unknown rule'. Update them in one PR.
One lock file maintenance branch per manager, so the nix one can run on its own schedule.
flake.lock follows nixpkgs-unstable on the next Renovate run instead of weekly, so nixpkgs security fixes land as soon as the channel has them.
